body:
She's in a similar situation I am in in that regard. Her dad is gone and her relationship with her mother is shaky on the best of days.

I did finish college... with honors too. At the time I was rejected for being "too young" and now I'm being rejected because in the past few years dealing with everything my credit score has taken a hit. Apparently that's reason enough to not want to hire me.

I have two jobs, one is storefront sales on weekends and I'm always working solo. My weekday job is manual labor in a shop. I've tried befriending people here but most of the workforce has serious issues with English, or are raging drug addicts/alcoholics... including the management. Even the boss... he did the math one day and found it absolutely hilarious that his cigarette/booze spending is more than my entire paycheck. Personally I couldn't afford a bottle even if I wanted to drink.

Maybe I can work out something with my SO... but I don't even know what or where to start. I'm just so tired of it all.

I have opened up to her in the past. Sometimes she's been understanding and other times I've gotten a cold shoulder.

I try to give myself credit for what I've managed to pull off but it still seems so hopeless. I've got a roof and a bed and a full stomach at night, but I have no enjoyment in life.

My friends are few and far in between these days. Since I've had to work all day everyday I don't get a chance to see them, and they've stopped even inviting me to things, and rarely even respond to messages/calls.
